notes: robots.txt allows our bot (it only bans named AI crawlers) and declares /sitemapExternal/sitemaps_index.xml -> per-year index sitemaps_index_2026.xml -> MONTHLY urlset sitemap_{MM}_{YYYY}.xml (zero-padded month, no per-day file, no HTML date archive: /archiv, /nachrichtenarchiv and /archiv/YYYY-MM-DD all return the JS shell); every <loc> is an article /<section>/<slug>/<9-10 digit id>.html with <lastmod> = publication time, so 28-170 URLs/day for all 31 days of 2026-09-25..10-25 and articles give 4.7-6.5k chars after tag stripping (no hard paywall on the HTML).
